Workflows.title: Start a bank simulator session, verify the dashboard is usable, and view account activity
Workflows.goal: The bank simulator landing page is loaded with the Get Started button; The main bank simulator dashboard is displayed with checking account view button; The Account Activity page is displayed showing account transactions; Account activity view updates to selected account tab
Workflows.starting_hint:
1. Open the bank simulator landing page — The bank simulator landing page is loaded with the Get Started button
2. Start the simulator session and dismiss the welcome dialog — The main bank simulator dashboard is displayed with checking account view button
3. Navigate to Checking Account Activity — The Account Activity page is displayed showing account transactions
4. Switch account views between Savings and Checking — Account activity view updates to selected account tab
